DB locales: No CHIA among 149 published Supabase keys/234 versions as of 2026-10-26. No stable key/family/DOI hit in prior Master 4013 keys, registered tab11 or PR495 386-item index.

Instrument (EN): Academic Anxiety Scale — original 11-item edition revalidated in United States university students
Scales / measured domains (EN): Single overall academic anxiety construct across educational tasks and settings. Evidence for unidimensional latent structure (EGA) and criterion associations; NOT a test-anxiety subscale battery.
Research provenance: Thomas CL, Journal of Psychoeducational Assessment, first online 2026-10-08, DOI 10.1177/07342829261495667. Revalidation of existing Cassady et al. 2019 AAS11, NOT new 2026 scale. N557 US undergraduate/graduate convenience pool; predominantly female n480 (87.6% of those with reported gender); graph EGA one community, alpha .90 omega .91; negligible DIF by gender/first-generation status in this sample.
DB locales: No identical named AAS11 instrument/key/source in all 4013 Master references, registered tab11 or original 386 PR495 index; no corresponding published Supabase definition.

Other translations: Other translations not independently identified; don't confuse generic academic anxiety instruments named AAS.
Target population: N557 primarily female US university students (undergraduates and graduates), college setting only; no clinical or general age/population norms.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: RESEARCH_ONLY / PERMISSION_REQUIRED. 2026 CC BY publication is NOT proof of underlying Cassady 2019 questionnaire author rights for paid hosted item display and automated scoring. Verify owner item wording/score instructions, respondent digital licence and educational privacy safeguards.
Verification notes / safety gate: Cassady et al. 2019 ORIGINAL, Thomas 2026 replication/reanalysis. One dimension; 2026 subgroup DIF insufficient to claim cross-language invariance or broad clinical use. Distinct from FRIEDBEN Test Anxiety Scale.
